channel.title: The Wiser One — A daily quote, quietly delivered
channel.description: Anybody can make it complicated. That's the default. Getting it simple is the work.

item.title: A CV tells you where somebody has been. It says nothing… — The Wiser One
item.description: A CV tells you where somebody has been. It says nothing about whether they'll fight for it.
item.author: The Wiser One
